crossRefs.note: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not…
As he spoke these things, many believed in him.
When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.
“For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.

translations.web: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
translations.bsb: Go up to the feast on your own. I am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet come.”
translations.kjv: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
translations.asv: Go ye up unto the feast: I go not up unto this feast; because my time is not yet fulfilled.
